title: paris verticillata subsp. manshurica
intro: Paris verticillata subsp. manshurica, commonly known as the Chinese mandrake, is a plant species belonging to the family of barberry (Berberidaceae) and is native to East Asia. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Paris verticillata subsp. manshurica include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and improve cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
